name: unresolvedRootCauseVulnerabilitiesCount
definition: The number of open NodeZero weakness series whose vuln_category is a systemic root-cause category (for example security misconfiguration) rather than a one-off CVE patch.
population: Weakness series in the weakness series page for one NodeZero tenant whose status is not closed, counted when vuln_category is one of the transform's ROOT_CAUSE_CATEGORIES.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: For 0: the page holds at least one series, and no open series falls in a root-cause category. An empty page is not 0.

changeLog.change: Registered so the Horizon3 NodeZero transforms can emit it; the meaning is what the transform reads, stated precisely. Unverified fields are named in notes.

notes: Only the NodeZero transform emits this key today. Field names are as that transform reads them; they were not live-verified against a NodeZero tenant, so the key stays proposed at V0 with the owner not yet named. The category list is the transform's own judgement of which categories are systemic; it is not a NodeZero-published taxonomy.
